DROP PROCEDURE [OM].[SP_TASK_START]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_TASK_START] @task_name [varchar](30),@pipeline_runid [VARCHAR](36),@data_layer [nvarchar](150),@process_date [datetime] AS

BEGIN

    DECLARE @FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
	
	SELECT
	@FLAG_CNT=COUNT(*)
	FROM 
		[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
	WHERE
		OTR.TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name) AND
		OTR.PROCESS_DATE = @process_date
		
	IF(@FLAG_CNT>0)
	  BEGIN
		   PRINT('JOB WAS ALREADY EXECUTED SUCCESSFULLY, SKIPPING EXECUTION')
		   --RAISERROR('JOB %s WAS ALREADY EXECUTED SUCCESSFULLY, SKIPPING EXECUTION', 16,1,@task_name)
		   RETURN 0
	  END

	IF(@FLAG_CNT=0)
	   BEGIN
		   ---START TASK
			INSERT INTO 
			[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] 
			(
				TASK_RUN_ID,
				TASK_NAME,
				PIPELINE_RUNID,
				STATUS_ID,
				DATA_LAYER,
				PROCESS_DATE,
				START_DATETIME,
				END_DATETIME,
				CREATE_DATETIME
			)
			SELECT  
				 @pipeline_runid 
				,UPPER(@task_name)
				,@pipeline_runid
				,(SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'RUNNING')
				,UPPER(@data_layer)
				,@process_date
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
				,NULL
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)		
	   END
	
END
GO
